confirmation.if_best_is_default: no confirmation is run; the estimate is reported as: no searched configuration beat the default on the panel
confirmation.missions: 32 rounds, trained on the 12 development families, tested on all 16 (as Stage 3)

deviations_from_draft: Search reduced from 64 configurations x 8 panel seeds to 32 x 4, for compute; the estimate of the best fixed Imp is therefore less thorough, and BOUNDED can be claimed only for the searched space.
Configuration distributions were specified at this freeze, not in the draft.
Registration is the public GitHub commit, not OSF.
estimate: T2-P = BEST - DEFAULT at round 32 with a 95% bootstrap interval; BOUNDED if the upper limit is < +1.0 pp, HEADROOM otherwise (protocols/analyze.py)

search.configurations: the default Imp plus 32 random configurations, drawn with random.Random(20261015)
search.distributions: multiplicative parameters log-uniform within their registered bounds (proposal and screening-related biases in [0.05, 8], step scale in [0.2, 4], sampling budget in [300, 4000]); integer edit count uniform on 0..8; operator mixture Dirichlet(1); partner base uniform in [0.05, 0.95]; screening penalty uniform in [0, 3]. Editing-procedure parameters are irrelevant with Imp frozen and keep their defaults.
search.missions: Imp frozen at each configuration (condition C6f with that initial Imp), 32 rounds, trained and tested on the 12 development families
search.selection: BEST = highest mean round-32 test solve rate over the panel; ties to the lower index; the default is index 0

status: frozen before any T2 mission was run
study: T2: the best a fixed Imp can do (reduced design)
